wiki.title: Splatoon Wiki Guide: Inkipedia & Splatoon 3 Databases
wiki.description: Looking for a Splatoon wiki? Compare Inkipedia, a datamined Splatoon 3 weapon and gear database, Chinese and Japanese strategy wikis and a lore archive.
wiki.heading: Splatoon wikis and Splatoon 3 databases
wiki.intro: The Splatoon wikis and reference sites players use for weapons, gear, abilities, stages and modes, plus a datamined stats database, strategy wikis in Chinese and Japanese, and an archive of Splatoon lore.

faq.question: What is the best Splatoon wiki?
faq.answer: Inkipedia covers mechanics, weapons, gear, stages, modes and updates in English. For exact weapon and gear numbers, Leanny's database is built from datamined game files.

faq.question: Is there a Splatoon 3 wiki in Chinese or Japanese?
faq.answer: Ikanimo (splatoon.com.cn) is a Chinese information, guide and data site, and the wikiwiki.jp Splatoon 3 wiki covers strategy and mechanics verification in Japanese.

tools.title: Splatoon 3 Tools: Builds, Schedules, Stats & Randomizers
tools.description: Splatoon 3 tools for gear builds, tournaments, battle and Salmon Run schedules, battle stats, replay analysis, top-player VODs and weapon randomizers.
tools.heading: Splatoon 3 tools
tools.intro: Websites the community uses to plan gear builds, check the current battle and Salmon Run schedules, track battle results, analyze replays, study top players' matches and pick random weapons.

faq.question: Where can I find Splatoon 3 gear builds?
faq.answer: sendou.ink collects builds from top players alongside its tournaments and seasonal ladder, and the Splatoon 3 Weapon Analyzer breaks down weapon and build data.

faq.question: How do I check the current Splatoon 3 schedule?
faq.answer: splatoon3.ink shows the current battle rotations and Salmon Run schedule, and Splatoon 3 Calendars turns battle, Salmon Run and event schedules into a calendar feed you can subscribe to.

faq.question: How can I track my Splatoon 3 battle stats?
faq.answer: stat.ink records and charts your battle results over time, and Inksight analyzes replays for match data and player stats.

faq.question: How do I pick a random weapon in Splatoon 3?
faq.answer: Nkitten's Splatoon 3 Randomizer is an English tool that randomizes weapons, stages and modes and can split players into teams. splatool.net's weapon roulette assigns weapons to 1 to 10 players and shares the result as a URL, and kyanu.net's roulette draws 1 to 10 weapons and can leave out ones you don't own. Both roulettes are in Japanese.

development.title: Splatoon 3 Developer Tools: SplatNet 3 APIs & Libraries
development.description: Open-source Splatoon 3 developer resources: SplatNet 3 API clients, a command-line uploader for stat.ink, and a Splatoon-inspired React component library.
development.heading: Splatoon 3 developer resources
development.intro: Open-source projects for building on Splatoon 3: clients for the Nintendo Switch Online and SplatNet 3 APIs, a battle-data exporter for stat.ink, and UI components.

faq.question: How do I get my Splatoon 3 data out of SplatNet 3?
faq.answer: s3s is a command-line tool that takes battle data from SplatNet 3 and uploads it to stat.ink. nxapi is an API client and desktop app for the Nintendo Switch Online app that can also access SplatNet 3 data.

assets.title: Splatoon 3 Assets: Fonts, Models, Sprites & Cursors
assets.description: Splatoon 3 fan assets: Inkling-language fonts and cipher charts, 3D models and sprites, cursor packs, Octo Expansion fonts, music archives and outfit catalogs.
assets.heading: Splatoon 3 assets
assets.intro: Fonts, models and textures, cursor packs, music and outfit references for fan art, mods and designs.

faq.question: Where can I download Splatoon 3 models and textures?
faq.answer: The Models Resource and The Spriters Resource both host Splatoon 3 model, sprite and texture rips.

faq.question: Is there a font for the Inkling language?
faq.answer: decipher.ink offers Splatoon script fonts and cipher charts, plus a generator that renders in-universe glyph images.

apps.title: Splatoon 3 Apps: Battle Stats, Desktop Pets & More
apps.description: Fan-made Splatoon 3 apps: Conch Bay for schedules and battle stats on iOS and Android, squid desktop pets, and a free real-time Inkling voice changer.
apps.heading: Splatoon 3 apps
apps.intro: Fan-made apps for phone and desktop: check schedules and battle statistics, keep a squid pet on your screen, or talk like an Inkling or Octoling.

faq.question: Is there an app to check Splatoon 3 schedules and battle stats?
faq.answer: Conch Bay is a cross-platform app for iOS and Android that shows Splatoon 3 schedules and battle statistics.

faq.question: Is there a Splatoon desktop pet?
faq.answer: memesquid and little squid pet are squid desktop pets; little squid pet can also recognize wins and losses and react to live chat.

official.title: Official Splatoon 3 Websites and Accounts
official.description: Official Splatoon 3 links from Nintendo: the English, Japanese and Hong Kong (Chinese) official websites and the official SplatoonJP account on X.
official.heading: Official Splatoon 3 links
official.intro: Nintendo's own Splatoon 3 websites in English, Japanese and Chinese, plus the official account that posts news and announcements.

faq.question: Where is the official Splatoon 3 website?
faq.answer: Nintendo runs the English site at splatoon.nintendo.com, a Japanese site on Nintendo Japan, and a Chinese-language site on Nintendo Hong Kong. News and announcements are also posted by the official SplatoonJP account on X.

bots.title: Splatoon 3 Bots: Schedules, Splatfests & Player Stats
bots.description: Splatoon 3 bots for Discord, QQ, Telegram and KOOK: look up battle and Salmon Run schedules, Splatfests and player stats, or follow a schedule feed on X.
bots.heading: Splatoon 3 bots
bots.intro: Add schedule and stats lookups to your Discord, QQ, Telegram or KOOK group, or follow an account that posts every rotation.

faq.question: Is there a bot that posts Splatoon 3 schedules?
faq.answer: The splatoon3.ink account on X posts map rotations, Salmon Run schedules and SplatNet gear automatically. For a group chat, the splatoon3-schedule NoneBot2 plugin answers schedule queries on QQ, OneBot, Telegram, KOOK and Discord.

faq.question: Can a bot look up the players I met in a match?
faq.answer: paul-sama/splatoon3-bot looks up stats of players encountered in matches, on KOOK, Telegram and Discord.

homeFaq.question: What is Awesome Splatoon3?
homeFaq.answer: A community-curated, searchable list of Splatoon 3 resources in English and Chinese: official links, wikis, tools, developer resources, assets, apps and bots.

homeFaq.question: How do I see my Splatoon 3 battle history on my phone?
homeFaq.answer: Nintendo's Nintendo Switch App (formerly the Nintendo Switch Online app) links up with Splatoon 3 through SplatNet 3, where you can look back at your battles and Salmon Run shifts. To keep and chart them long-term, see stat.ink under Tools and Conch Bay under Apps.

homeFaq.question: Is there a Splatoon 3 weapon randomizer?
homeFaq.answer: Yes. Nkitten's Splatoon 3 Randomizer picks random weapons, stages and modes and can split players into teams, and splatool.net and kyanu.net offer Japanese weapon roulettes with filters for weapon class, sub and special. All three are listed under Tools.

homeFaq.question: How can I suggest a resource?
homeFaq.answer: Press Contribute at the top of the page and fill in the form. It opens a pre-filled GitHub issue for you.
